source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Adding x-moz-ews to MESSAGE_PROTOCOLS routes EWS message documents through the content-script matcher's existing message permission check. That check requires messagesModify, or messagesRead together with scripting. It does not grant a new permission or register every protocol globally. The direct test registers a message-display script, opens an EWS message and waits for its notification; it was not run.
title: EWS message scripts use the existing message-scheme permission branch
